name: Stampede Medallion (Major)
text:
When crafted, a stampede medallion looks like nothing more than small silver disk, about the same size as a silver piece. When you invest this medallion for your eidolon, it changes shape to appear as a tiny, bejeweled facsimile of the eidolon, magically attached just over your eidolon's heart. While your eidolon wears the medallion, they gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to shove or trip.

Activate—Impossible Tide 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect Your eidolon momentarily manifests into a stampede of dozens of copies of themself. The stampede rampages out in every direction, swerving around your allies while trampling any foe on the ground in an emanation around your eidolon with a radius equal to your eidolon's Speed. Each of these foes takes 14d6 bludgeoning damage, with a DC 38 basic Reflex save save. On a critical failure, the foe is also knocked Prone. After dealing damage, the stampede of eidolons vanishes as quickly as it appeared.
